name: warm-cafe-blue-feather-girl
image_purpose: Create a social lifestyle cafe portrait with distinctive blue feather styling.

prompt.project_info: UGC social-cozy public-indoor warm cafe portrait.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult person seated at a cafe table, with long straight blonde hair, natural volume, realistic pores and a luminous satin makeup base with subtle neutral lip gloss. Preserve the approved adult identity reference if supplied; do not use a celebrity or public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait 3:4 iPhone-style framing. The subject leans forward at a dark tiled table, framed by a plate holding a large flaky croissant. Preserve the light blue camisole, voluminous shaggy light-blue feathered jacket, wide silver cuff and delicate pendant necklace.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm dim cafe atmosphere with bright HDR-style fill lifting shadows, creamy natural complexion, visible pores and crisp digital texture; keep the whole composition in focus without background blur.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic ultra-sharp iPhone 15 Pro photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, crisp full-scene focus, realistic hands and anatomy, natural photographic variation, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic ultra-sharp iPhone 15 Pro photograph of one approved adult person seated at a dark tiled table in a warm dimly lit cafe. The subject leans forward, framed by a plate holding a large flaky croissant. They wear a light blue camisole under a voluminous shaggy light-blue feathered jacket, a wide silver cuff and a delicate pendant necklace. Long straight blonde hair has natural volume. Bright HDR-style fill lifts the shadows, revealing realistic creamy skin with visible pores and crisp digital texture. Luminous satin-finish makeup and subtle neutral lip gloss, entire composition in crisp focus without background blur, warm cozy cafe atmosphere, 3:4 aspect ratio.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, real-person likeness, celebrity resemblance, watermark, logo, text, signature, stamp, copyright, username, date, blurry, low quality, distorted hands, fused features, unnatural anatomy, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR artifacts

assets.name: approved adult appearance reference

assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult's facial structure, proportions, natural skin texture and hair direction without celebrity resemblance or beautification.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult appearance reference.
